description: Permanently publish public content: index one agreement/v1 object (POST /agreements); confirm=true required. Its CID is computed and the object checked locally first: it must be exactly the published form, and sponsor must be the wallet that will mint it. designs carries linked designs the index does not hold yet (a parcel layout is published only this way). The index refuses inputs that differ from the union of the designs' bindings. A community vote (rule electorate community, binding false, no approvalConfig) stays a poll in the index; a binding owners' agreement (electorate owners, binding true, an approvalConfig with the owners' parcel-rights and policy, rule.lens one lens key) can be minted. Returns the CID and, with a sponsor, the chain account a binding agreement will be minted as.

anyOf.description: An agreement/v1 object exactly as the app publishes it: schema, title, author, sponsor, city, createdAt, designs [{ cid, goal, title }], inputs { parcels, openGroundM2 }, outputs, allocations, money, rule, deadline. JSON Schema: ugt_help({topic:"schemas/agreement"}) → schema.$defs.agreement

cid.description: Agreement CID (bafkrei…), as ugt_propose_agreement or ugt_list_agreements answers it

confirm.description: Explicitly authorize this write, paid or signed devnet action

designs.description: Only unpublished designs from the referenced plan that the index does not yet hold. Omit already indexed designs; the plan lists the complete design selection.

content.description: A design/v1 object exactly as the app publishes it: schema, goal, title, description, author, city, site, toleranceM, geometry, origin, authoredAt (each present, null when empty) and one payload (roadProposal, buildingProposal, structureProposal or parcelLayout). JSON Schema: ugt_help({topic:"schemas/design"}) → schema.$defs.design

expectedCid.description: Required for a reference; retain the CID from the reviewed revision.
